items.title: docs(#6062): Atlas-to-ID publication format design
items.body: Design deliverable for #6062: publication contract mapping Atlas corpus records (logical files, immutable versions, chunks/occurrences, ingest runs with attestations) and PROV-lite provenance/lineage relations into existing ID-graph objects. Key decisions: - D1: canonical in Atlas tables; ID graph is a projection (re-projection rebuild). - D2-D5: versions to document.put, logical files to note.create/revise chains, occurrences as tag claims (heads full, history by reference), ingest batches as one attestation.claim per batch digest. - D6: PROV-lite relations as atlas.* namespaced tag.set claims with fixed directionality; note.link explicitly not the carrier. - Consumes #3125 occurrence semantics and the landed #5545 writer-set projection (PR #6672) without redefining either; takes #6022 placement as input without selecting note classes. - Replay/correction/retention/consistency rules (§6), projection versioning (§7), open items with stated defaults (§8). Design-only; no implementation. Follow-ons in §9. Acceptance audit in Appendix A; cross-reference audit in Appendix B. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? items.title: feat(note-submission): placement classification and routing (#7717)
items.body: ## What Implements #7717: policy-aware placement classification + routing in `pkgs/note-submission`, per the merged #6022 placement policy (PR #7719) and the #6062 publication boundary (PR #7998), extending the crate landed by #10936 / PR #10991. - `classify()` — §2 decision-table routing over the declared class + `RoutingContext` (registry-selected Zettel corpus, owning repo, explicit tier request, §5 ID-native eligibility evidence) + sensitivity ceiling → `Routed(PlacementDecision)` / `NotPublished` / fail-closed `StaysStaged`. - Atlas physical tiers (public/internal/secret) resolve only after the ceiling: default internal; public/secret explicit; internal ceiling forbids public; secret-bearing requires explicit secret and is never ID-native (§5); personal/local-only never route. - ID-native routing requires all §5 conditions plus the graph object id as canonical identity and a named #5545 writer-set; no parallel relation or permission schema is introduced — the object format stays #6062's. - `stage_classified()` stages routed decisions into the existing human gate; `promote()`'s approval and corpus-control rechecks run immediately before publication, unchanged. - `tests/routing.rs` — table-driven coverage of every §2 class (selected destination, Atlas treatment, ID-native eligibility), fail-closed cases, ceiling/tier resolution, and a stage → human approval → publish end-to-end test verifying content hash and provenance against the submission record. ## Verification Laptop run (private target dir, sccache disabled per #13367): `cargo test --all-targets` — 13 passed, 0 failed (7 pre-existing pipeline tests + 6 new routing tests). `cargo fmt --all` applied. items.title: doc: agent-note placement design — zettel vs repo vs ID graph (#6022)

labels.name: audit:completed-later
labels.description: Gap completed by later merged PR

items.body:
Design record for #6022 (Atlas programme #6018, S7–S10). Queue task 12877.

## What this decides

Where agent notes live, as one applicable rule:

- **The one-step test (§1):** would the note still be true, and still be looked for, if the repo it is about were deleted tomorrow? Yes → zettel (knowledge about the world). No → the repo (knowledge about the artifact). Neither yet → workspace/memory (knowledge about the current attempt).
- **Decision table (§2):** 10 note classes → home → lifetime → Atlas ingestion tier (0 = ID-native, 1 = first-class corpus, 2 = repo corpus, 3 = provenance only).
- **Promotion paths (§4):** scratch → zettel only via the single `note_submission` envelope → Turso submission DB → staging → human promotion; nothing auto-commits.
- **ID-graph publishing (§5):** qualifying classes (cited across systems + stable identity + nameable writer-set per #5545), PROV-lite relations per #6062 in the #5686 vocabulary; graph object canonical for ID-native notes, repo/zettel copies become projections. Memory content never goes ID-native.
- **Migration (§6):** move on next touch with pointer stubs; no big-bang; memory and sandbox-environment material (hatch-personal, per #5981/#5983) do not move.

## Follow-ons filed

- #8204 — envelope declares placement class + tier
- #8205 — one-step test pointer in the note-filing docs
- #8206 — pointer-stub sweep for promotions
- #6062 (already open) owns the ID-native format §5 consumes

Design only; no implementation in this PR.

items.title: feat(atlas): project explicit file-note binding and revision lineage claims
items.body:
## Summary

```text
explicit file -> note-create keys + explicit Atlas revision edges
  -> atlas.fileId on stable note-create event
  -> atlas.specializationOf on every version (including backfills)
  -> atlas.wasRevisionOf per explicit edit/rename/split/merge predecessor
  -> typed event resolution -> bounded NFC JSON tag value
```

Slice 4 for #11182. Additive `project_lineage_claims` emits unsigned descriptors only; existing immutable document, complete-head-history and explicit head/backfill APIs are unchanged. Content/path never imply lineage. External note-create bindings are caller-attested, not inferred; revision endpoints must be in the supplied immutable batch. Actual resolved IDs must be 64 lowercase hex characters; final JSON is capped at 512 UTF-8 bytes. No signing/publication is wired.

Issue #11182 remains open. Remaining scope: tombstones, correction clears, other PROV relation families and runtime signing/publication.

## Evidence

- **Before:** test-first empty-output baseline `614226253dc8a76f7bc34e626d958cb8090e4c69`, [Fleet red run 45508443240](https://github.com/dezren39/fleet/actions/runs/45508443240), terminal failed on the expected empty-output assertion (0 passed, 1 failed, 217 filtered).
- **After:** candidate `d20564bfd7c7c03451c7fc0b5cd899216bdf8bbf`, [Fleet targeted run 45509064155](https://github.com/dezren39/fleet/actions/runs/45509064155), execution step succeeded; terminal cleanup in progress. Command: `cd pkgs/atlas-search && cargo test -p atlas-core --lib version_projection`.
- Oracle: recomputation from explicit Atlas fixture row keys/bindings/edges. Independent files, renames, shared blobs, backfills, external note binding, split/merge predecessors, replay permutation determinism, invalid references/confidence and exact 512/513-byte final JSON boundaries. Typed resolver IDs distinguish note/document namespaces.
- Read-only workhorse correctness review approved; suggested wire/boundary coverage added. `rustfmt` and `git diff --check` passed. No local builds. PR #14649 merged before this PR; actual main merged into branch. No automatic PR test gate under current CI policy.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** narrow.

Additive unsigned Atlas projection API and fixture metadata only. Publisher must resolve/validate subject hashes separately and attest external note-create identities.
